scripts.build:registry: (cd packages/foundation && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/react && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/react-tailwind && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/solid && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/solid-tailwind && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && rm -rf website/docs/public/r/foundation website/docs/public/r/react website/docs/public/r/react-tailwind website/docs/public/r/solid website/docs/public/r/solid-tailwind && (cd packages/foundation && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/foundation) && (cd packages/react && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/react) && (cd packages/react-tailwind && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/react-tailwind) && (cd packages/solid && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/solid) && (cd packages/solid-tailwind && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/solid-tailwind) && oxfmt
scripts.check:packages: pnpm run check:package && pnpm run check:package:react-tailwind && pnpm run check:package:solid && pnpm run check:package:solid-tailwind
scripts.changeset:release: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run check:packages && changeset publish
